title: How is the All projects column laid out now that the Conductor talks there?
lead: Pick how the All projects column fits the Conductor's chat. I recommend B: the chat and its message box fill the column like any thread, with small "waiting" and "agents" rows on top that open in place. On the phone, "waiting" opens by itself whenever something needs you. Confidence: medium.
for_you: What you type and what the Conductor answers sit together, as in every other thread
Waiting cards and the agents list are still one tap away, and on the phone what needs you still comes first

for_you.text: Changes the column order from decision 42; switching back is a page change only

context: Decision 42 laid out All projects as a count bar, Needs you grouped by project, then every agent. Decision 55 added the Conductor's chat at the top of that column, with its message box at the very bottom, so the waiting cards and the agents list sat between what Matt types and what the Conductor answers. Matt called it discombobulated. conductor-build mocked two layouts on the real page with fake data, at desktop and phone width.

options.name: Waiting on top, chat below
options.summary: Waiting cards at the top, the agents list folded to one row, then the Conductor chat ending at the message box.
cons: With several cards waiting, the chat drifts away from the box again

options.name: Chat fills the column, rows on top
options.summary: The chat and message box fill the column like any thread. Two compact rows on top, "2 waiting" and "9 agents", open in place. On the phone, "waiting" opens by itself whenever something waits and folds with one tap.
pros: Quiet when nothing waits; phone still leads with what needs you
cons: On the desktop, waiting cards are one tap away rather than always shown

recommendation: B keeps the chat whole however many cards wait, and the red count on the waiting row still tells you at a glance.
change_mind: If you find yourself opening the waiting row every time on the desktop, take A.

images.caption: A on the desktop: waiting cards, folded agents row, then the chat
B on the desktop: the chat fills the column, waiting and agents rows on top
B on a phone: waiting open by default when something waits
